lines.en: In these halls, hooves beat louder than hearts.
My shadow has four legs.

lines.zh: 石板上三道爪痕，是我留的。
lines.en: Three claw marks on the slab are mine.
Walk slower, so prey shows itself.

lines.zh: 我嗅着墙根走，味道最浓。
lines.en: I walk the wall's base, where scent is thickest.

lines.zh: 鼻息喷在门框上，结了一层雾。
lines.en: My breath fogs the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我的背脊刮过灯笼，火苗歪了。
lines.en: My spine scrapes the lantern; the flame leans.

lines.zh: 两条腿还是四条，我懒得数。
lines.en: Two legs or four, I no longer count.

lines.zh: 靴声藏在蹄声里，没人听得出。
lines.en: Bootsteps hide inside hoofbeats; no one hears.

lines.zh: 我绕圈走，把气味撒成一堵墙。
lines.en: I circle, laying scent like a wall.

lines.zh: 铁链拖在身后，是圣所拴的。
lines.en: Chains drag behind me, tied by the sanctum.
At every corner I pause three breaths.
I hear rats on the beams.
Hungry; my stomach is louder than my thoughts.

lines.zh: 舌头舔过獠牙，磨得发亮。
lines.en: My tongue polishes these tusks.
The sanctum's feed trough is empty.
Lying down, plate digs into my ribs.
Someone counts behind the door: one, two...
Half an arrow is stuck in my hide.

lines.zh: 这具身子，是被拼出来的。
lines.en: This body was assembled, not born.

lines.zh: 我咬着柱子，磨平一颗牙。
lines.en: I chew the pillar and wear down a tooth.
The lantern sways, and I want to pounce.

lines.zh: 呼吸太重，惊跑了墙里的虫。
lines.en: My breathing is too heavy; it scares the worms.

lines.zh: 圣所给我套项圈，还叫它礼制。
lines.en: The sanctum calls my collar a rite.
I smell leather armor and sweat.
Lie too long and my hind legs go numb.
You are slightly wider than the door gap.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙看，别误会。
lines.en: I am watching your throat; do not misread it.
Your eyes are moving like a runner's.
I inhale, and you step back.

lines.zh: 你的味道，我在三里外就闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled you three li out.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看看你有多大的胆。
lines.en: Look up; let me see how much nerve you carry.
Your hands shake, and so does your armor.
Do not blink while I am watching.
You stand very straight, like bait.
My pupils are brighter than the lantern.

lines.zh: 你腰间那把东西，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the thing at your belt.
I am waiting for your knees to weaken.
Wherever you run, I arrive first.
I will remember that face in my teeth.

lines.zh: 你站在光里，正好被我看见。
lines.en: You stand in the light, right where I can see you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里最软。
lines.en: I stare at your knees. Softest spot.
You blinked. I noted that.
Your shadow lies right against my feet.
Thick hide; that did not reach flesh.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，像猪，不像兽。
lines.en: I grunt like a pig, not a beast.

lines.zh: 你砍在旧疤上，白费力气。
lines.en: You struck an old scar; wasted effort.
That sting is nothing next to hunger.
I step back to get a running start.
Not the nose; that is the soft spot.
Quick hands, but weak.
A patch of fur gone; my back feels cold.
I shake my head and fling sweat on the wall.
Again; I have not started panting.
Meat? Throw it farther; I hate walking.
That piece in your hand is too small.
I do not eat what is handed to me.
Set it down, step back, then I sniff.

lines.zh: 圣所的料槽，从来不给饱。
lines.en: The sanctum's trough never fills me.
Hold it longer and your arm tires first.
Bones will do; meat is better.
I have bitten the hand that fed me.
That smells like medicine, not food.
Do not wave it; it makes my teeth itch.
To bump me you must reach my shoulder.
My hide is thick; that felt like scratching.

lines.zh: 让开，我转身要一整条走廊。
lines.en: Clear out; my turn needs the whole corridor.
One brush from me and you stagger.
Do not stand by my hind legs.
My tail knocked the lamp.
Pushing me is like pushing a wall.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，硌得我不舒服。
lines.en: The iron on you is uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我肩一沉，你就退了两步。
lines.en: I drop a shoulder, and you back off twice.
Do not crowd the door; the frame remembers.
A creature like me breeds nothing.
The sanctum builds, it does not raise.
My litter was split apart long ago.
Pairing? Ask the collar first.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都是编号。
lines.en: Even my name is a number.

lines.zh: 两只这样的，会拆了走廊。
lines.en: Two of us would take the corridor apart.
The dams are elsewhere, not here.

lines.zh: 我舔过一只小兽，它跑了。
lines.en: I licked one cub; it ran.
Here they add beasts, not families.
My den is a cold stone slab.
Fallen meat is mine.
My nose arrives before my head lowers.
Is this edible? One bite to check.
You drop it, I take it; we are even.
Iron chips hurt my teeth; I spit it out.
My claws are clumsy with fine things.
I keep bones for my teeth.
The sanctum's books ignore what I scavenge.

lines.zh: 别伸手，那是我先看见的。
lines.en: Do not reach; I saw it first.
This cloth carries your scent.
Stranger scent, from the north cloister.
I stop; my ears turn toward you.
You cracked a tile.
A shadow moves in the door gap.
I smell iron, and fear.

lines.zh: 谁把外面的风放进来了？
lines.en: Who let the outside wind in?
My heart speeds up. Yours?
Something is running inside the sanctum.
I heard you swallow.
Breathing behind the corner — two of them.
I have smelled this before.
You hide poorly; your shadow shows.

lines.zh: 项圈在响，它认出了猎物。
lines.en: The collar rings; it knows prey.

lines.zh: 我从暗处站起来，比门高。
lines.en: I rise from the dark, taller than the door.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味最重，就你。
lines.en: You smell most of iron. You, then.

lines.zh: 我趴低身子，地砖都烫了。
lines.en: I crouch, and the floor tiles heat up.
You take three steps; I take one leap.
I do not run straight; I cut corners.
Look back, and I am there.
Do not shut the door; it will not stop my shoulder.
I hug the wall to stay quiet.
The harder you pant, the closer I am.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，第三步扑。
lines.en: I count your steps; the third is my pounce.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到我身后。
lines.en: Your torch cannot reach behind me.
I am in your shadow; stop searching.
The hinge creaked; you will not get far.
I am slow because the hall is narrow.

lines.zh: 你选了死路，还跑得挺快。
lines.en: You chose a dead end and ran fast anyway.

lines.zh: 猎物停下来，就是想通了。
lines.en: When prey stops, it has understood.
I open my mouth, and the corridor goes quiet.

lines.zh: 你走这条路，我先到尽头。
lines.en: Take this hall. I will be at the end first.

lines.zh: 我压低肩，别误会，这是要撞。
lines.en: I lower my shoulder. Do not mistake it for a bow.

lines.zh: 你退到火把下，光帮不了你。
lines.en: You back under a torch. The light will not help.

lines.zh: 我绕柱走，柱子挡不住鼻子。
lines.en: I circle the pillar. Pillars do not stop my nose.
This charge pins you to the door.
Tusks first, claws after.
My forelegs rise; you grow shorter.

lines.zh: 别抓我的角，那是圣所安的。
lines.en: Do not grab my horns; the sanctum fitted them.
I bite your armor and fling.
This claw leaves three marks.
Roll to the wall; that clears the path.
I use my shoulder, not my teeth.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，我咬得更用力。
lines.en: You wear iron, so I bite harder.
You blocked it. Is your hand still there?
I toss my head, and you fly.

lines.zh: 这一下算轻的，我还没饿。
lines.en: That was gentle; I am not hungry yet.

lines.zh: 退到柱子后，我就拆柱子。
lines.en: Hide behind the pillar; I will take it apart.
I pin you down and sniff at leisure.
This shove pins you to the wall.
I bit off course and only tore cloth.
The door opens; the chain rattles first.

lines.zh: 我从料槽边醒来，槽是空的。
lines.en: I wake by the trough; it is empty.

lines.zh: 圣所的灯太亮，我的眼还没适应。
lines.en: The sanctum lamps are too bright for my eyes.

lines.zh: 项圈扣紧了，我该出去巡。
lines.en: The collar tightens; time to patrol.
Someone taps the wall three times.
I smell someone new.

lines.zh: 铁栅升起，石板震了一下。
lines.en: The portcullis rises; the slab shudders.
I shake the dust off my back.

lines.zh: 这一趟，圣所放我出来找东西。
lines.en: This time the sanctum lets me hunt.

lines.zh: 爪子在地砖上刮了两下。
lines.en: I scrape my claws twice on the tiles.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头有光，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Light at the corridor's end; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，梁上的灰落下。
lines.en: I growl once, and dust falls from the beams.

lines.zh: 他们解开链子，却没解项圈。
lines.en: They unchained me, not my collar.

lines.zh: 我迈出门，影子铺满整条廊。
lines.en: I step out; my shadow fills the hall.

lines.zh: 料槽空了，我就自己出去找。
lines.en: The trough is empty, so I go find my own.

lines.zh: 脖上的项圈勒了我一下。
lines.en: The collar bit into my neck once.
I shake my head and fling off the dust.
The sanctum door shuts behind me.
My fur is burning; what a stench.
The steps are narrow; my hooves slipped.

lines.zh: 水漫到胸口，我不擅长这个。
lines.en: Water at my chest; this is not my element.

lines.zh: 火药震得我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast leaves my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 肩上的箭，我当作新长的角。
lines.en: The arrow in my shoulder is a new horn.
The spell makes my legs weak.
The trough has been empty two days; I counted.
The thunder is louder than my roar.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我抓不到东西。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; my claws find no hold.
